note: Lander County (NV) publishes its zoning only as static PDF maps (2010 master plan Figures A-2 Battle Mountain Town Zoning and A-4 Battle Mountain Area Zoning). No queryable ArcGIS REST zoning district layer was found in ArcGIS Online/Hub searches or county pages. The assessor's GIS viewer (experience.arcgis.com) could not be inspected for a zoning layer. The state parcel layer (arcgis.water.nv.gov County_Parcels_in_Nevada) has no zoning field, so it is not a fallback. No city in the county publishes zoning GIS separately; Battle Mountain is governed by the county's zoning.
